title: Artificial intelligence
content: Artificial intelligence is intelligence demonstrated by machines. AI systems are used for language processing, image recognition, planning, and decision-making.

title: Large language model
content: A large language model is a language model trained with a large number of parameters on extensive text data. Large language models can generate and summarize natural-language text.

title: Wikipedia
content: Wikipedia is a free online encyclopedia written and maintained by a community of volunteers. Its articles are available in many languages.

title: Python (programming language)
content: Python is a high-level general-purpose programming language. It was created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991.

title: Streamlit
content: Streamlit is an open-source Python framework for building data applications. It provides interactive web user interfaces from Python code.

title: FAISS
content: FAISS is a library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors. It was developed by Meta AI Research.

title: Natural language inference
content: Natural language inference determines whether a premise entails, contradicts, or is neutral toward a hypothesis.
